title: RMOS-AUTHORITY-MAP-001 Stage 1: one-off manufacturing authority census (not an agent)
intent: Rewrite RMOS-AUTHORITY-MAP-001 as a plain one-off RMOS audit/consolidation increment and deliver Stage 1 only: one census script, one inert capability registry, one JSON Schema, one checkpoint report, MAR-001–008 and MAR-021–024 tests, GA-TRIAL-0002 in the existing Grounding trial ledger, and a pointer on the historical RMOS audit. Grounding Agent v0.1 remains the only agent under trial. No new agent identity, workflow, orchestration, or standing mapper service. No production CAM/RMOS/feasibility/route/client/persistence/G-code behavior change. Stage 1 dispositions are UNKNOWN / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; stop at the Step-7 taxonomy checkpoint.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds a rewritten Dev Order that forbids a second agent, a read-only census script (scripts/audit/rmos_authority_map.py) that walks FastAPI _IncludedRouter mounts, an inert manufacturing_authority_registry.json seeded UNKNOWN, its JSON Schema, Stage-1 checkpoint audit, a dated pointer on rmos_prod_audit_001.md, GA-TRIAL-0002 on the existing Grounding ledger, and 22 pytest witnesses (MAR-001–008, MAR-021–024). Nothing production-facing imports the registry. No tools/ package, no new GitHub workflow, no Grounding Agent code change.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Existing RMOS audits and live_routes.json are route censuses and historical leads. There is no capability-level manufacturing reachability registry, and adjacent maps (CANONICAL_AUTHORITY_MAP, geometry_authority_registry, ontology_authority_map) explicitly do not own machine-output authority. This increment is the evidence artifact a later cutover would consume; it introduces no runtime authority.
